nodes.label: D-001: ESP32 Module is WROOM
nodes.rationale: User confirmed WROOM, so GPIO16/17 stay on PMS7003 UART2; clears the WROVER PSRAM blocker (Plan 7.4).

nodes.label: D-002: BLE UUIDs Frozen (d0ca5a prefix)
nodes.rationale: Fresh v4 UUIDs generated and frozen in Contract section 2 incl. two reserved spares; firmware and app hardcode the same constants; regeneration forbidden without a new decision entry.

nodes.label: D-003: JSON Encoding with ArduinoJson 7.x
nodes.rationale: Plan section 12.2 omitted a JSON library although section 3.4 mandates JSON; ArduinoJson 7.x added alongside NimBLE 2.x, exact versions pinned at phases 1/2.

nodes.label: D-004: uint64 NVS Counter Design
nodes.rationale: fanSeconds u32 overflows in ~12 days at max speed (4.3e10 > 2^32); both integrals stored uint64 end-to-end (fanSec RPM s, pwfs RPM µg s); runtimeHours/powerOnHours merged into single onSec; redundant rt payload key dropped; app must use 64-bit ints (web not a target).

nodes.label: D-005: Working Firmware v4 and Version Scheme
nodes.rationale: firmware/baseline/docasa-air-purifier-v3.ino stays pristine forever as the diff target; active sketch firmware/docasa-air-purifier-v4/ seeded byte-identical; FIRMWARE_VERSION MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with 4.1.0 = after Phase 2.

nodes.label: D-006: Android-First App Target
nodes.rationale: Android Studio toolchain; iOS deferred, foreground-first caveats noted; iOS-specific work out of all current phase estimates.

nodes.label: D-007: App State Management - Riverpod
nodes.rationale: First-listed in Plan 6.1 layering; testable without hardware, DI-friendly for the fake BLE layer.

nodes.label: D-008: App Local DB - Drift (SQLite)
nodes.rationale: Typed queries suit the downsampling/aggregation pipeline per Plan 6.1.

nodes.label: D-009: Android minSdk Decision
nodes.rationale: Recommendation 31 to avoid legacy location-permission BLE scan path; Phase 3 pre-set to 26; revisit before public release.

nodes.label: D-010: Write Command Security (pending)
nodes.rationale: Passkey-on-TFT conflicts with the 1.4 display freeze (finding R3); options: in-scope passkey display, unauthenticated writes with app-side confirm UX, or app-held PIN; dev builds ship unauthenticated for MVP.

nodes.label: D-011: Filter Budgets and Preset Models (pending)
nodes.rationale: loadBudget/hourBudget are app-side config; ship configurable defaults (~3000 h nominal) plus settings UI until the real filter model is chosen.

nodes.label: D-012: App History Retention Policy
nodes.rationale: 1 Hz recording is ~86k samples/day; resolved ladder raw 1 Hz kept 24h, 1-min aggregates 7d, 1-h aggregates 90d; compaction every 60 s while connected.

nodes.label: D-013: Phase-0 Toolchain Pins
nodes.rationale: arduino-cli 1.5.1, ESP32 core 3.3.12, FastLED 3.10.8, Adafruit display/sensor libs, Flutter 3.47.9 / Dart 3.13.7; baseline compile clean with 0 warnings; FQBN is esp32:esp32:esp32 (esp32dev alias removed).

nodes.label: D-014: NimBLE 2.5.2 + ArduinoJson 7.4.3 Pins
nodes.rationale: API drift vs 1.x: NimBLE 2.5.2 has no getSubscribedCount(); CCCD gating implemented via onSubscribe callback flags reset on disconnect; v4.1 compile-verified.

nodes.label: D-015: Phases 1+2 Merged into v4.1.0
nodes.rationale: Single firmware session (user-approved); v4.1 code-complete and compile-verified; bench gates G1/G2 deferred to Bench-Runbook when hardware arrives; Command char handles time now, ignores resetFilter until Phase 5; diff gate PASS (312 added, 0 removed/changed).

nodes.label: D-016: Phase 3 Dependency Pins and Retention
nodes.rationale: flutter_riverpod 3.4.3 (resolves D-007), drift 2.35.3 (resolves D-008), flutter_blue_plus 2.3.14 pre-pinned, fl_chart 1.3.0, flutter_local_notifications 22.3.3 (named initialize/show API + desugaring), sqlite3_flutter_libs removed; retention ladder coded (resolves D-012); minSdk pre-set to 26 (per D-009).
